item.text:
You can see this in Mistral’s **[Model Selection Guide](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/compare)**. Select one or more models to compare their capabilities, specifications, benchmarks, latency, and pricing.

For a programmatic check, use the **[Models API endpoint](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/models)** (`GET /v1/models` or `GET /v1/models/{model_id}`), whose response includes a `capabilities` object such as chat completion, FIM, function calling, fine-tuning, vision, and classification.
